addendum_record.contents: Msg 677 trigger quoted; per-amendment landing table A-1..A-13; the A-13 flagged paragraph with evidence; the checked-and-held list restated as unedited.
addendum_record.section: 'Landing of the case-study amendments (2026-11-18, late evening)' — appended at end of file

ambiguities: A-5/A-7 placement: AMENDMENTS.md says 'template §2 storyline block' / '§2 sign-off'; template §2 is a single sign-off code block with no separate storyline block. Most literal reading applied: a new STORYLINE DECLARATIONS block was placed at the head of §2 containing AUDIENCE_SECRET and HANGER_PAID.

Pass numbering: AMENDMENTS.md directs a new 'Pass 3.6 — LINE SHAPE' at the end of §1 of DIALOGUE_METHOD.md, while the template independently numbers its §2 sign-off block 'PASS 3.6 — DIALOGUE BUILD'. The amendment's literal numbering was followed in the method; the two documents' pass numbers are independent and no renumbering was improvised.

§6 grep contract: extended to cover every new template label (line_genre_move, PROOF_OBJECT, REACTION, AUDIENCE_SECRET, HANGER_PAID, length_trait, poster_frame_verdict, CAPTION_RULE), including where an individual amendment's (iii) named only its field — the template's own standing contract ('if a future amendment adds a rule, it adds a label here in the same commit, or the rule does not exist') and the landing brief both require it.

landings.edit: Every harvested line also carries a GENRE MOVE tag (ACCUSE-WITH-PROOF / DENY / ENTER-CONTRADICT / REVEAL-BY-AUTHORITY / NONE); ten moves = intent, four = genre function received; NONE presumed orphan until defended at the Stranger Test; tags checked in GATE_LOG after the test against Q2.
line_genre_move field added beside line_move / line_target and added to the §6 per-unit label list.
landings.section: §4.4 LINE LEDGER — line_genre_move field; §6 grep contract; §7 row 20

landings.edit: Each unit's driving claim is assigned a named physical proof object before banter; accusations must touch the object; conflict shown then named, never reported secondhand.
landings.section: Pass 3.1 — new 'Banter input — the proof object' paragraph

landings.edit: The first spend of a driving fact is the object beat (object shown and named); a driving fact is never first spent as a report of something off-screen.
Per-unit PROOF_OBJECT field added (object shown AND named; unit goes back to banter if its conflict survives the object's removal; NONE option for units with no driving claim).
Harvest-time drafting rules: payload word last; names rationed to emphasis / accusation / entrance. Explicitly not a gate; the plainness pass does not repair toward them.
landings.section: New Pass 3.6 — LINE SHAPE, at the end of §1

landings.edit: Scripted silence is a REACTION entry with a named carrier, zero words, react move; exempt from the repeated-beat rule when its carrier changes; the three digestion gaps are written as REACTION entries.
landings.section: Pass 3.2 — new 'Reactions are lines too' paragraph

landings.edit: REACTION entry added with fields carrier / duration / follows_line, beside the dialogue entries.
landings.section: §4.4 SPEECH BLOCK — REACTION entry type; §6 grep contract; §7 row 22

landings.edit: The audience secret (planted no later than U1's close) is a fact whose first spend is to the audience: shown, not said.
AUDIENCE_SECRET field (secret, holder, planted_in_unit) added at the head of §2.
landings.section: §2 STORYLINE DECLARATIONS — AUDIENCE_SECRET field; §6 grep contract; §7 row 23

landings.edit: Fact spend is checked against the series RUNNING_BRIEF (who knows which secret, who is lying to whom, last hanger promised, current stake numbers); continuity editor owns it, updates at every lock; a room session that opens without reading it is out of order.

amendments.note: Per AMENDMENTS.md (iii) the RUNNING_BRIEF is a series-level artifact beside the show bible, not an episode-template field; no template field was added. Creating the per-show files is not an edit to the three target documents — rooms create them at the next storyline pass under this discipline.

landings.edit: Hanger rollover only with interest paid in the same episode; next episode's first beat pays the previous hanger at least partly within ~5s before a larger debt; no payment beat and no interest = does not lock.
HANGER_PAID field (previous hanger; how beat one pays it) added beside AUDIENCE_SECRET in §2.
landings.section: §2 STORYLINE DECLARATIONS — HANGER_PAID sign-off; §6 grep contract; §7 row 24

landings.edit: The verdict line must be speakable in-scene as the episode's moral in one plain sentence (what changed, as a judgment), without naming the premise or restating U1; failure surfaces at Stranger Test Q4. No new template field, per AMENDMENTS.md (iii).
SPEECH_RULE also carries a habitual length trait; line length is a distinguishing character trait; the two designed speakers' length traits must differ.
length_trait field added directly under SPEECH_RULE on the cast card and to the §6 per-character label list.
landings.section: §1 cast card — length_trait clause on SPEECH_RULE; §6 grep contract; §7 row 25

landings.edit: The banter draft is defined as one continuous two-voice transcript of the scene played in order — not a pool of candidate lines; a line pool is named as the board by another name.
Field description rewritten to the transcript definition, including recording each harvested line's transcript line number in the move ledger.
POSTER_FRAME block added (frame_one_still, poster_pitch_read, poster_frame_verdict PASS/FAIL) — the EMPTY CAPTION test at the master gate.
landings.section: §5.4 — POSTER_FRAME check beside Gate (f); §6 grep contract (poster_frame_verdict); §7 row 27

amendments.note: Per AMENDMENTS.md (iii) the CAPTION_MODE declaration itself lives in each show bible, which is not one of the three assigned target documents; the template block names the declaration and its location. DIALOGUE_METHOD.md untouched, as directed (packaging, not dialogue).

landings.edit: CAPTION_RULE added: one-line platform captions pick exactly one form — REACTION / TORN_FRAGMENT / CHEAP_QUESTION — and never describe, summarize, or hashtag-explain the episode.
landings.section: New §5.5 Delivery — social caption step (CAPTION_RULE); §6 grep contract; §7 row 28

amendments.note: AMENDMENTS.md (iii) also names the release plan's caption guidance as a landing spot; the release plan is outside the three target documents assigned for this landing, so only the template landing was made.

landings.edit: Line-length discipline worded into Pass 3.6: one idea per line, usually ≤12 words, payload last, short and one-word lines normal and licensed; the F-26 8-14-word band applies as a ceiling range, not a target band; over-full scenes return to banter for compression. F-25 unit caps explicitly untouched.

Recorded as a FLAGGED application change to ratified F-26, landed by parent ruling, with the case-study evidence cited (KreatorFlow smoothie scene; '…Strawberry.'; THE_STANDARD.md §1; the brainrot study's per-clip reading of the band) and the F-25-untouched boundary stated.
Register row records A-13 as flagged, landed in DIALOGUE_METHOD Pass 3.6 and the addendum; F-25 caps untouched.
